sentences.en: One of the bleak realities of the COVID-19 pandemic
sentences.zh: COVID-19大流行的一个严酷现实是

sentences.en: is that not every group has been affected equally.
sentences.zh: 并非每个群体受到的影响都是一样的。

sentences.en: Older Americans have suffered more than the young.
sentences.zh: 美国老年人受到的苦难比年轻人更多。

sentences.en: Residents of some cities and states
have faced a higher risk than others.
sentences.zh: 面临着比其他人更高的风险。

sentences.en: There are also vast racial disparities.
Black people make up 30% of the city's population.
They are 56% of the city's COVID-19 deaths.
sentences.zh: 他们占该市COVID-19死亡人数的56%。

sentences.en: Here in Los Angeles, 16% of deaths are African-American.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶，16%的死者是非裔美国人。

sentences.en: Only 9% of the population is African-American.
sentences.zh: 而非裔美国人仅占总人口的9%。

sentences.en: So I represent that legacy of growing up poor and Black in America,
sentences.zh: 所以我代表了在美国贫困和黑人环境中长大的历史背景，

sentences.en: and I and many Black Americans are at higher risk for COVID.
sentences.zh: 我和许多美国黑人面临着更高的感染COVID的风险。

sentences.en: Black Americans are far more likely than white Americans
sentences.zh: 美国黑人比白人更有可能

sentences.en: to have contracted the coronavirus or died from COVID-19.
Many of the reasons for these disparities
sentences.zh: 造成这些差距的许多原因

sentences.en: reach back to before the pandemic began.
sentences.zh: 在大流行开始之前就已存在。

sentences.en: There are long-standing inequities in the health care system.
sentences.zh: 医疗保健系统中长期存在不平等现象。

sentences.en: In 2019, we talked about a specific source of racial disparities.
sentences.zh: 在2019年，我们探讨了种族差距的一个具体根源。

sentences.en: We also considered an uncomfortable solution.
sentences.zh: 我们还考虑了一个令人感到不安的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's a timely topic, and we decided to bring it back today.
sentences.zh: 这是一个切合时宜的话题，我们决定今天重新拿出来讨论。

sentences.en: There is comfort in the familiar.
sentences.zh: 熟悉的事物总能带来慰藉。

sentences.en: That's why Marlon Wade likes to head over to his local barbershop, Wrist Action.
sentences.zh: 这就是马龙·韦德喜欢去当地的“腕部动作”理发店的原因。

sentences.en: It's on MacArthur Boulevard in Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 它位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰的麦克阿瑟大道上。

sentences.en: He doesn't come for a cut.
I just wear the bald head.
He comes to shoot the breeze.
He points to one of the barbers, who's a friend.
sentences.zh: 他指着其中一位理发师，那是他的朋友。

sentences.en: That's one of my old-school teammates.
sentences.zh: 那是我老派的队友之一。

sentences.en: Basically, Marlon likes to hang with people who know and understand him.
sentences.zh: 基本上，马龙喜欢和那些了解并理解他的人在一起。

sentences.en: Some years ago, when Marlon was in the market for a new doctor,
sentences.zh: 几年前，当马龙需要找个新医生时，

sentences.en: he looked for that same feeling of connection.
sentences.zh: 他也在寻找那种联系感。

sentences.en: I had over 20 doctors to choose from.
sentences.zh: 我有20多个医生可供选择。

sentences.en: She was, like him, black, and like him, a practicing Muslim.
sentences.zh: 她和他一样是黑人，也和他一样是一位虔诚的穆斯林。

sentences.en: She gets me, I get her.
We talk about life, we talk about our religion.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论生活，谈论我们的宗教。

sentences.en: You know, if something's wrong with me, she's going to let me know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我有什么不对劲，她会直言不讳地告诉我。

sentences.en: It's the kind of trusting relationship Marlon doesn't believe he'd find
sentences.zh: 马龙认为，这种信任关系他在

sentences.en: in a doctor of a different race.
sentences.zh: 其他种族的医生那里是找不到的。

sentences.en: I don't think a lot of these doctors relate to people of my skin color.
sentences.zh: 我认为很多这些医生无法与我肤色的人产生共鸣。

sentences.en: Like when it comes to heart disease, diabetes.
sentences.zh: 比如在心脏病、糖尿病方面。

sentences.en: Like a lot of these diseases can be researched and medically something done for it.
sentences.zh: 比如许多这类疾病可以被研究并在医学上采取措施。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, my community is not getting that service.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我的社区并没有得到这种服务。

sentences.en: A variety of studies do suggest that black men in America often receive inferior care
sentences.zh: 各种研究确实表明，美国的黑人男性往往会接受到劣质的医疗护理

sentences.en: They have the lowest life expectancy of any major demographic group.
sentences.zh: 他们在所有主要人口统计群体中的预期寿命最短。

sentences.en: Many of the diseases they are dying from are chronic or preventable.
sentences.zh: 他们死去的许多疾病都是慢性的或可预防的。

sentences.en: Now a growing body of research suggests Marlon Wade might be onto something
sentences.zh: 现在越来越多的研究表明，马龙·韦德的选择

sentences.en: The black doctors were able to convince more effectively the patients
sentences.zh: 与非黑人医生相比，黑人医生能够更有效地劝说患者

sentences.en: to take more of the preventative services compared to the non-black doctors.
sentences.zh: 接受更多的预防性服务。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we consider a simple but controversial way
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》节目中，我们探讨了一种简单但颇具争议的方法

sentences.en: to improve outcomes in medicine, education, and other fields.
sentences.zh: 来改善医学、教育和其他领域的成果。

sentences.en: And we ask, what happens when the ideal of a colorblind society
sentences.zh: 我们不禁要问，当“肤色盲”社会的理想

sentences.en: runs into hard evidence that you may get better outcomes by not being colorblind?
sentences.zh: 遇到确凿的证据时会发生什么——证据表明不搞“肤色盲”反而能取得更好的结果？

sentences.en: When Owen Garrick was a kid growing up in the South Bronx,
sentences.zh: 当欧文·加里克还是个在南布朗克斯长大的孩子时，

sentences.en: he lived across the street from a bunch of relatives, including his Uncle Bobby.
sentences.zh: 他住在许多亲戚的街对面，其中包括他的鲍比叔叔。

sentences.en: So he was the one that you could always hang out with.
sentences.zh: 所以他是那个你随时可以一起厮混的人。

sentences.en: To the mall, to the store, to some friend's house.
sentences.zh: 去商场，去商店，去某个朋友家。

sentences.en: You can go swimming with him.
sentences.zh: 你可以跟他一起去游泳。

sentences.en: He's a guy you can just jump in his car, come back at all hours of the evening,
sentences.zh: 他是一个你可以随时跳上他的车，到深夜任何时候才回来的人，

sentences.en: and he was your excuse, right?
sentences.zh: 他就是你的挡箭牌，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, Mom, Uncle Bobby, you know, had me staying out all night.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，妈妈，鲍比叔叔让我一直在外面待到很晚。

sentences.en: But when he was 66 years old, Uncle Bobby found out he was dying of prostate cancer.
sentences.zh: 但当他66岁时，鲍比叔叔发现自己患前列腺癌晚期。

sentences.en: So he started having bone pain due to the metastasis to his bone.
sentences.zh: 所以由于骨转移，他开始感到骨痛。
疼痛促使他去看了医生。

sentences.en: And so then he was diagnosed.
He probably died a few months after he was diagnosed.
sentences.zh: 他可能在确诊几个月后就去世了。

sentences.en: In Owen's opinion, it was a preventable death.
sentences.zh: 在欧文看来，这是一场本可以避免的死亡。
前列腺癌通常发展缓慢。

sentences.en: He could still be very much alive and still very much active in his community and with his family.
sentences.zh: 他本来还可以好好活着，在社区和家庭中依然非常活跃。

sentences.en: But unfortunately, wouldn't go in for preventative services.
sentences.zh: 但不幸的是，他就是不肯去进行预防性检查。

sentences.en: Owen says many of the older men in his family were the same way.
sentences.zh: 欧文说他家里的许多老年男性也是这样。
他们不去做预防性护理。

sentences.en: This is the kind of story told over and over again in Black America.
sentences.zh: 这就是在美籍黑人中一遍又一遍上演的故事。

sentences.en: And it's a story reflected in a grim statistic.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个反映在严峻统计数据中的故事。

sentences.en: The average life expectancy of Black men is 72 years, about four years shorter than the average for white men.
sentences.zh: 黑人男性的平均预期寿命是72岁，比白人男性的平均寿命短大约四年。

sentences.en: Most of the death is due to preventable or chronic conditions.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数死亡都是由可预防或慢性的疾病引起的。

sentences.en: This is something Owen wants to change.
sentences.zh: 这是欧文想要改变的事情。
他是一名医生兼研究员。

sentences.en: He runs Bridge Clinical Research, a company whose mission is to make the medical system work better for Black Americans.
sentences.zh: 他经营着“桥梁临床研究”公司，其使命是让医疗系统更好地服务于美籍黑人。

sentences.en: Owen is tired of the bad news about Black men and health care in America.
sentences.zh: 欧文已经厌倦了关于美国黑人和医疗保健的坏消息。

sentences.en: He's tired of talking about the disparity in health outcomes.
sentences.zh: 他厌倦了讨论健康结果方面的差距。

sentences.en: What Owen wants is a fix.
sentences.zh: 欧文想要的是一个解决方案。

sentences.en: A way to get Black men, particularly low-income Black men, to go to the doctor for preventative care.
sentences.zh: 一种让黑人男性，尤其是低收入黑人男性去看医生接受预防性护理的方法。

sentences.en: He wants doctors who will listen to patients.
sentences.zh: 他希望有倾听患者心声的医生。

sentences.en: And patients who will listen to doctors.
sentences.zh: 以及听从医生建议的患者。

sentences.en: So Owen and his fellow researchers, Marcella Alshon and Grant Graziani, designed a field study to try to answer one simple question.
sentences.zh: 于是欧文和他的同僚研究员马塞拉·阿尔雄和格兰特·格拉齐亚尼设计了一项实地研究，试图回答一个简单的问题。

sentences.en: Will Black men take more preventative care services if they're randomly assigned to a Black doctor?
sentences.zh: 如果随机指派一名黑人医生，黑人男性会接受更多的预防性护理服务吗？

sentences.en: Is it possible that the race of your physician matters in terms of your own health?
sentences.zh: 你的医生的种族是否会影响你自身的健康？

sentences.en: To find out, Owen and his colleagues rented a medical clinic in Oakland.
sentences.zh: 为了找出答案，欧文和他的同事在奥克兰租了一家医疗诊所。

sentences.en: They recruited 14 Black and non-Black doctors to staff the clinic during the study.
sentences.zh: 他们招募了14名黑人和非黑人医生在研究期间为诊所配备人员。

sentences.en: For patients, they turned to flea markets and barbershops in and around the East Bay.
sentences.zh: 至于患者，他们将目光投向了东湾及周边地区的跳蚤市场和理发店。

sentences.en: Places like Wrist Action, where Marlon Wade likes to hang out.
sentences.zh: 比如马龙·韦德喜欢去的“腕部动作”这样的地方。

sentences.en: And if you go to a Black barbershop, you will have all sorts of Black men in the barbershop.
sentences.zh: 如果你去黑人理发店，你会看到各种各样的黑人男性都在理发店里。

sentences.en: Not much, but how are you doing today?
sentences.zh: 没别的，就是今天过得怎么样？

sentences.en: You'll have folks who, like me, you'll have my kids at that barbershop.
sentences.zh: 你会看到像我这样的人，你会看到我的孩子们在那家理发店里。

sentences.en: You'll have folks who didn't graduate from high school and their kids.
sentences.zh: 你会看到没有高中毕业的人以及他们的孩子。

sentences.en: The first step was asking patrons in these places if they'd answer some basic questions.
sentences.zh: 第一步是询问这些地方的顾客是否愿意回答一些基本问题。

sentences.en: Some 1,300 men agreed to fill out a short survey about their socioeconomic status, health history, and level of trust in the medical system.
sentences.zh: 大约1300名男性同意填写一份关于他们的社会经济地位、健康史以及对医疗系统信任程度的简短问卷。

sentences.en: For these efforts, they received cash or a voucher for a free haircut, plus a coupon for a free health screening.
sentences.zh: 作为对这些努力的回报，他们获得了现金或免费理发的代金券，以及一张免费健康筛查的优惠券。

sentences.en: About half the men showed up at the clinic for that screening.
sentences.zh: 大约有一半的男性出现在诊所接受筛查。

sentences.en: Before their checkup, the clinic staff showed the men a picture of the doctor they'd been randomly assigned.
sentences.zh: 在体检之前，诊所工作人员向这些男性展示了随机指派给他们的医生的照片。

sentences.en: They also asked them to select from a list of preventative care services that they'd be willing to receive.
sentences.zh: 他们还要求他们从愿意接受的预防性护理服务清单中进行选择。

sentences.en: Heightened weight to check body mass index, blood pressure, cholesterol, which is total cholesterol, and a diabetes screen, which is hemoglobin A1c.
sentences.zh: 身高体重以检查身体质量指数、血压、胆固醇（即总胆固醇）以及糖尿病筛查（即糖化血红蛋白）。

sentences.en: At first, the men made similar choices.
sentences.zh: 起初，这些男性的选择很相似。

sentences.en: They all accepted generally the same level of preventative services.
sentences.zh: 他们普遍接受了大致相同水平的预防性服务。

sentences.en: In other words, seeing the photos of the doctors did not change patients' decisions about what services to accept.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，看到医生的照片并没有改变患者对接受何种服务的决定。

sentences.en: Typically, the men would choose some of the services, but not all.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，这些男性会选择其中的部分服务，而不是全部。

sentences.en: They might agree to get their body mass index and blood pressure checked, but forego the tests for diabetes and cholesterol that come with a needle stick.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会同意检查身体质量指数和血压，但放弃需要扎针的糖尿病和胆固醇检测。

sentences.en: But what happened next changed their choices.
sentences.zh: 但接下来发生的事情改变了他们的选择。

sentences.en: The doctor then comes in and says, okay, Mr. Smith, you've only selected these three.
sentences.zh: 医生随后走进来，说道：好吧，史密斯先生，你只选了这三项。

sentences.en: You know, you've only selected height and weight and blood pressure.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你只选了身高体重和血压。

sentences.en: We really recommend that you take all five because they're all recommended.
sentences.zh: 我们强烈建议你把五项全做了，因为这些都是推荐的。

sentences.en: They're all good for your health.
sentences.zh: 它们对你的健康都有好处。

sentences.en: As I said, some of the black patients were randomized to receive this advice from a black doctor, some from a non-black doctor.
sentences.zh: 如我所说，一些黑人患者被随机分配接受来自黑人医生的建议，另一些则来自非黑人医生。

sentences.en: Did the race of the physician affect what patients did?
sentences.zh: 医生的种族是否会影响患者的做法？

sentences.en: The black doctors were able to convince more effectively the patients to take more of the preventative services.
sentences.zh: 黑人医生能够更有效地劝说患者接受更多的预防性服务。

sentences.en: And not just by a little, by a lot.
sentences.zh: 而且不是一点点，是大幅度提高。

sentences.en: The black doctors were about 20% more successful than non-black doctors at getting patients to have their blood pressure and body mass measured.
sentences.zh: 在让患者测量血压和身体质量方面，黑人医生的成功率比非黑人医生高出约20%。

sentences.en: They were even more effective at persuading their patients to have invasive tests.
sentences.zh: 他们在劝说患者进行侵入性检查方面甚至更有效。

sentences.en: For diabetes and the flu shot, the black doctors were about 50% more successful than non-black doctors.
sentences.zh: 对于糖尿病和流感疫苗，黑人医生的成功率比非黑人医生高出约50%。

sentences.en: And then came the cholesterol results.
sentences.zh: 接下来是胆固醇检查结果。

sentences.en: There was a 72% difference in the ability of the black doctor to recommend and have the black male patient take cholesterol screening compared to the non-black doctor.
sentences.zh: 与非黑人医生相比，黑人医生推荐并让黑人男性患者接受胆固醇筛查的能力存在72%的差异。

sentences.en: Now, the real-life implications of these results might be significant.
sentences.zh: 这些结果在现实生活中的意义可能十分重大。

sentences.en: High cholesterol, for instance, can lead to heart attacks, strokes.
sentences.zh: 例如，高胆固醇会导致心脏病和中风。

sentences.en: What if black patients in the real world responded to their physicians like their counterparts in the study?
sentences.zh: 如果现实世界中的黑人患者对医生的反应能像研究中的同行那样呢？

sentences.en: Owen Garrick says the gap in the United States between blacks and whites in cardiovascular disease outcomes might shrink by nearly 20%.
sentences.zh: 欧文·加里克表示，美国黑人和白人在心血管疾病结果方面的差距可能会缩小近20%。

sentences.en: That could be 20% of the people living to see their grandkids graduate from college in high school, right?
sentences.zh: 那可能意味着有20%的人能够活到看到他们的孙辈从大学和高中毕业，对吧？

sentences.en: That's how I think about it.
These results suggest they might be an easy, low-cost way to save the lives of black men.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，这可能是一种简单、低成本的方式来挽救黑人男性的生命。

sentences.en: Owen and his colleagues wanted to understand what was going on.
sentences.zh: 欧文和他的同事们想要弄清楚究竟是怎么回事。

sentences.en: Why were the black doctors so much more effective?
sentences.zh: 为什么黑人医生的效果会好这么多？

sentences.en: The researchers didn't think prejudice was at play because the patients rated all the physicians, black and non-black, as equally good.
sentences.zh: 研究人员认为偏见并没有在起作用，因为患者对所有医生——无论是黑人还是非黑人——的评价都一样好。

sentences.en: But then they discovered a clue.
sentences.zh: 但随后他们发现了一个线索。

sentences.en: It was in the notes the doctors had written about their patients.
sentences.zh: 这个线索藏在医生们关于患者的病历记录中。

sentences.en: We found that the black doctors actually wrote more notes compared to the non-black doctors about their patients.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，与非黑人医生相比，黑人医生实际上写了更多关于患者的病历记录。

sentences.en: And often those notes talked about their non-healthcare issues.
sentences.zh: 而且这些记录往往涉及医疗之外的话题。

sentences.en: Will the warriors repeat as NBA champions?
sentences.zh: 勇士队能卫冕NBA总冠军吗？
也就是，非医疗性质的问题。

sentences.en: The black doctors and black patients were connecting as human beings.
sentences.zh: 黑人医生和黑人患者正在作为有血有肉的人进行心灵沟通。

sentences.en: They were talking about family, sports, life.
sentences.zh: 他们在聊家庭、体育、生活。

sentences.en: It's the kind of chit-chat that says,
sentences.zh: 这就是那种闲聊，它传递出一种信号：

sentences.en: I know where you're coming from.
Marlon Wade from the barbershop made the very same point about his doctor.
sentences.zh: 理发店的马龙·韦德对他的医生也有完全相同的看法。

sentences.en: She gets me, I get her.
We talk about life, we talk about our religion.
sentences.zh: 我们聊生活，聊我们的宗教信仰。

sentences.en: You know, if something's wrong with me, she's going to let me know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我身体出了什么毛病，她会告诉我。

sentences.en: Owen's research is part of a growing body of work that suggests
sentences.zh: 欧文的研究是一系列日益增多的研究成果的一部分，这些研究表明

sentences.en: matching patients and doctors by race can make a difference in health outcomes.
sentences.zh: 根据种族来匹配患者和医生，可能会对健康结果产生影响。

sentences.en: In another study, researchers found that Florida patients assigned to physicians of their own race
sentences.zh: 在另一项研究中，研究人员发现，被分配给同种族医生的佛罗里达州患者

sentences.en: were 13% less likely to die while in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 在住院期间死亡的概率要低13%。

sentences.en: These results were driven almost entirely by black patients matched with black physicians.
sentences.zh: 这些结果几乎完全是由与黑人医生相匹配的黑人患者带来的。

sentences.en: The research raises difficult questions about our medical system, our society, and our biases.
sentences.zh: 这项研究引发了关于我们的医疗系统、我们的社会以及我们的偏见的沉重问题。

sentences.en: The clearest takeaway from the research is that warm and empathetic communication matters.
sentences.zh: 这项研究最明确的启示是，热情且充满同理心的沟通至关重要。

sentences.en: Owen Garrick believes that doctors might be taught to bridge some of the differences he observed in his study.
sentences.zh: 欧文·加里克认为，或许可以通过培训医生，来弥合他在研究中观察到的一些差异。

sentences.en: Because if communication is the mechanism, you can train, or you should be able to train
sentences.zh: 因为如果沟通是其中的机制，你就可以对非黑人医生进行培训，或者说你应该能够培训他们

sentences.en: non-black doctors to more effectively communicate with their patients.
sentences.zh: 让他们能够更有效地与患者沟通。

sentences.en: There is a more daunting takeaway.
sentences.zh: 还有一个更令人望而生畏的启示。

sentences.en: If you want better outcomes in health care, especially among the most vulnerable patients,
sentences.zh: 如果你想要改善医疗保健的效果，尤其是在最脆弱的患者群体中，

sentences.en: having a more diverse pool of physicians is crucial.
sentences.zh: 拥有更多元化的医生队伍是至关重要的。

sentences.en: Owen says what he wants is for patients to have a choice.
sentences.zh: 欧文表示，他希望患者能够拥有选择权。

sentences.en: If they want to see a black doctor, they can choose one.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想看黑人医生，他们可以选择。

sentences.en: But right now, that's often not possible.
sentences.zh: 但目前，这往往是不可能的。
因此存在代表性不足的问题。

sentences.en: It's important to note that choice is not just something blacks might prefer.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，选择权不仅仅是黑人可能会偏爱的东西。

sentences.en: In a follow-up survey, Owen and his team found that both black and white respondents
sentences.zh: 在后续的一项调查中，欧文和他的团队发现，无论是黑人还是白人受访者
都表现出对同种族医生的偏好。

sentences.en: 65% of blacks surveyed said a black doctor would better understand their concerns.
sentences.zh: 65%受访的黑人表示，黑人医生能更好地理解他们的关切。

sentences.en: 70% of whites said a white doctor would better understand them.
sentences.zh: 70%的白人表示，白人医生能更好地理解他们。

sentences.en: There is a third implication of Owen's research, and it feels radioactive.
sentences.zh: 欧文的研究还有第三个启示，而且这个启示听起来极其敏感。

sentences.en: Given the results, I asked him,
should hospitals and medical centers match patients and doctors by race,
sentences.zh: 医院和医疗中心是否应该按种族来匹配患者和医生，

sentences.en: particularly when it comes to black men?
sentences.zh: 特别是在面对黑人群体时？

sentences.en: Owen challenged the notion that this needed to be a radioactive idea.
sentences.zh: 欧文对这种把这变成一个敏感话题的观点提出了质疑。

sentences.en: Fraternities and sororities self-select by gender.
sentences.zh: 兄弟会和姐妹会都是按性别自行选择的。

sentences.en: You could argue that that's segregation.
I wouldn't argue that that's segregation.

sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，可能会有人这么认为。
你知道的，悲观主义者可能会这么想。

sentences.en: And I think in the pessimists of the world
sentences.zh: 我想世上的悲观主义者

sentences.en: might argue that recommending black physicians for black patients is segregation.
sentences.zh: 可能会认为，为黑人患者推荐黑人医生就是种族隔离。

sentences.en: I don't see it that way.
Still, Owen acknowledges he would be uncomfortable with the idea
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，欧文承认，如果出现这样一种想法，他会感到不安：

sentences.en: that hospitals would deliberately steer black patients to black doctors
sentences.zh: 医院故意把黑人患者引导到黑人医生那里，

sentences.en: and white patients to white doctors.
sentences.zh: 把白人患者引导到白人医生那里。

sentences.en: After all, we struggled as a nation for decades to overcome segregation.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，我们作为这个国家为了克服种族隔离奋斗了几十年。

sentences.en: How would patients react if they were told when they showed up at a clinic,
sentences.zh: 如果患者来到诊所时被告知，

sentences.en: you're black, so we're sending you to the black doctor?
sentences.zh: 你是黑人，所以我们把你送去给黑人医生看病，他们会作何反应？

sentences.en: There is some tension here, right?
sentences.zh: 这其中存在一些紧张关系，对吧？

sentences.en: Because there are two values, I think, that are in conflict with one another here.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为这里有两种价值观存在冲突。

sentences.en: I mean, there is one value that basically says, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一种价值观基本上说的是，你知道的，

sentences.en: we should all essentially treat one another the same.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上都应该以相同的方式对待彼此。

sentences.en: We should all get along well.
We should all, you know, as Dr. King would say,
sentences.zh: 我们都应该，正如马丁·路德·金博士所说的那样，

sentences.en: look at each other's character and abilities and not the color of our skin or our gender.
sentences.zh: 看重彼此的品格和能力，而不是看我们的肤色或性别。

sentences.en: I mean, so that is an ideal.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一种理想。

sentences.en: And the other ideal is we should trust the data and we should trust the evidence
sentences.zh: 而另一种理想是，我们应该相信数据，我们应该相信证据，

sentences.en: and we should follow where the evidence leads.
sentences.zh: 我们应该顺应证据所指的方向。

sentences.en: And it feels like those two values, following the evidence and the data
sentences.zh: 感觉这两种价值观——顺应证据和数据，

sentences.en: and following this norm that we have about how we'd like our society to be,
sentences.zh: 以及顺应我们对社会应有形态的这种规范——

sentences.en: these two values are in conflict.
sentences.zh: 这两种价值观发生了冲突。

sentences.en: And they're partly in conflict because we don't live in an ideal world.
sentences.zh: 而且它们之所以部分冲突，是因为我们并非生活在一个理想世界中。

sentences.en: And some might argue, skeptics of the world might argue that we profess to live in an ideal world
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会争辩，世上的怀疑论者可能会争辩说，当我们分明知道世界绝非理想时，

sentences.en: when we know absolutely the world is not ideal.
sentences.zh: 却声称自己生活在一个理想世界中。

sentences.en: So given that, given the cards you're dealt, the life you live, the world we exist in,
sentences.zh: 所以鉴于此，鉴于你拿到手牌局、你所过的人生、我们所处的这个世界，

sentences.en: how do you best, in our case, accomplish improved health outcomes for all populations
sentences.zh: 在我们的情况下，你如何才能最好地实现改善所有人健康的成果，

sentences.en: and specifically in our research study, the black male population.
sentences.zh: 具体到我们的研究中，即改善黑人群体的健康成果。

sentences.en: And this issue of the race of the doctor seems to work.
sentences.zh: 而医生种族这个问题似乎确实管用。

sentences.en: And it isn't just in medicine.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅体现在医学领域。

sentences.en: When we come back, the results of matching people by their identities,
sentences.zh: 稍后回来，我们将为您揭晓根据身份匹配人群所带来的结果，

sentences.en: from education to retail to banking.
In 1985, researchers in Tennessee launched a massive experiment
sentences.zh: 1985年，田纳西州的研究人员发起了一项大规模实验，

sentences.en: to see if class sizes affected learning.
sentences.zh: 旨在观察班级规模是否会影响学习。

sentences.en: There was plenty of anecdotal evidence at the time,
sentences.zh: 当时有大量轶事证据表明，

sentences.en: suggesting that kids did better in smaller classes,
sentences.zh: 小班授课能让孩子们学得更好，

sentences.en: but there was no hard data to prove it.
sentences.zh: 但却没有确凿的数据来证明这一点。

sentences.en: More than 11,000 students from kindergarten through third grade
sentences.zh: 来自幼儿园到三年级的11000多名学生

sentences.en: were randomly assigned to one of three class size groups.
sentences.zh: 被随机分配到三种班级规模组别中的一组。

sentences.en: Researchers tracked their performance over time.
sentences.zh: 研究人员长期追踪了他们的表现。

sentences.en: The experiment is now considered one of the most important education studies ever conducted.
sentences.zh: 这项实验现在被认为是开展过的最重要的教育研究之一。

sentences.en: It showed that smaller class sizes led to substantial improvements in early learning,
sentences.zh: 它表明，较小的班级规模可以显著促进早期学习的进步，
尤其是对少数族裔学生而言。

sentences.en: In the decades since, researchers have also come to realize
sentences.zh: 在此后的几十年里，研究人员也逐渐认识到，

sentences.en: the random placement of kids in Project STAR could be used to study something else.
sentences.zh: “明星计划”中对孩子们的随机分配可以用来研究其他问题。

sentences.en: If you are randomizing by class size,
sentences.zh: 如果你是按班级规模随机分配的，

sentences.en: you are also randomizing by teacher race.
sentences.zh: 你其实也是按教师种族随机分配的。

sentences.en: She is an education professor at the University of North Carolina in Chapel Hill.
sentences.zh: 她是北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校的一位教育学教授。

sentences.en: She said this insight led to a new research question.
sentences.zh: 她说，这一洞察引出了一个新的研究问题。

sentences.en: Do children who have a teacher of the same race
sentences.zh: 拥有同种族教师的孩子，

sentences.en: do better than children who don't?
sentences.zh: 会不会比没有同种族教师的孩子表现得更好？

sentences.en: Education researcher Thomas Dee was the first to analyze the Project STAR data in this new way.
sentences.zh: 教育研究员托马斯·迪是第一个用这种新方法分析“明星计划”数据的人。

sentences.en: Did students do better if they were matched with a teacher of the same race?
sentences.zh: 如果学生与同种族教师相匹配，他们的表现会更好吗？
康斯坦斯说，这些结果令人瞩目。

sentences.en: If you're a black student and you have a black teacher,
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个黑人学生，并且你有一位黑人老师，

sentences.en: on average you're going to have a higher test score than a black student who has a white teacher.
sentences.zh: 平均而言，你的考试成绩会比由白人老师教的黑人学生更高。

sentences.en: The findings weren't just specific to black kids.
sentences.zh: 这些发现并不仅仅局限于黑人儿童。

sentences.en: They also held true for white students.
sentences.zh: 它们对白人学生同样适用。

sentences.en: Both black and white kids did better on math and reading achievement tests
sentences.zh: 无论是黑人还是白人孩子，如果在数学和阅读成就测试中

sentences.en: if they had a teacher of the same race.
sentences.zh: 拥有一位同种族的老师，他们的成绩都会更好。

sentences.en: Thomas Dee worried that his results might cause people
sentences.zh: 托马斯·迪曾担心他的研究结果可能会引发人们

sentences.en: to call for increased racial segregation in schools.
sentences.zh: 呼吁增加学校中的种族隔离。

sentences.en: He felt that would be a mistake.
sentences.zh: 他觉得那将是一个错误。

sentences.en: He first noted that his results only applied to how kids were doing
sentences.zh: 他首先指出，他的结果只适用于孩子们在

sentences.en: The results did not predict achievement over longer time periods.
sentences.zh: 这些结果并不能预测更长时间跨度内的学业成就。

sentences.en: Second, he felt the best takeaway would be more study.
sentences.zh: 其次，他认为最好的启示是进行更多的研究。

sentences.en: He urged researchers to continue exploring
sentences.zh: 他敦促研究人员继续探索

sentences.en: why race dynamics matter in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 为什么种族动态在课堂上很重要。

sentences.en: Fourteen years later, Constance Lindsay and her colleagues did just that.
sentences.zh: 十四年后，康斯坦斯·林赛和她的同事们正是这样做的。

sentences.en: Basically, what we did is we said,
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们所做的就是：

sentences.en: let's use the fact that we can follow the students over many, many years
sentences.zh: 利用我们能够对学生进行长达多年追踪的优势，

sentences.en: and see what happens to them in terms of high school dropout,
sentences.zh: 看看他们在高中辍学方面情况如何，

sentences.en: whether they take a college entrance exam,
sentences.zh: 他们是否参加了大学入学考试，

sentences.en: and then whether they enroll in college.
sentences.zh: 以及他们随后是否进入大学就读。

sentences.en: In other words, they tried to answer the open question Thomas Dee had raised.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们试图解答托马斯·迪提出的那个开放性问题。

sentences.en: Do black children who were randomly assigned to black teachers
sentences.zh: 被随机分配给黑人教师的黑人儿童，

sentences.en: perform better over the long term?
sentences.zh: 在长期来看表现会更好吗？

sentences.en: What they found is those early interactions had a lasting effect.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，那些早期的互动产生了持久的影响。

sentences.en: Black students in our sample who were matched to a black teacher
sentences.zh: 我们样本中与黑人教师相匹配的黑人学生

sentences.en: were less likely to drop out of high school,
sentences.zh: 高中辍学的可能性更小，

sentences.en: more likely to sit for a college entrance exam.
sentences.zh: 参加大学入学考试的可能性更高。

sentences.en: So think, you know, SAT, ACT,
and then more likely to enroll in college.
sentences.zh: 进而更有可能进入大学就读。

sentences.en: The success of black students increased
with every year they were matched with black teachers.
sentences.zh: 随着他们与黑人老师相处年限的增加而提高。

sentences.en: Black students who spent more time with black teachers
sentences.zh: 花更多时间与黑人老师在一起的黑人学生

sentences.en: did better than black students who spent less time.
sentences.zh: 比花较少时间的黑人学生表现得更好。

sentences.en: These results could have huge implications.
sentences.zh: 这些结果可能会产生巨大的影响。

sentences.en: They suggest that race matching might be one way
sentences.zh: 它们表明，种族匹配可能是让更多面临辍学风险的黑人孩子

sentences.en: to get more at-risk black kids to stay in school
and go on to higher education.
sentences.zh: 并继续接受高等教育的一种方法。

sentences.en: Of course, Tennessee is just one state,
sentences.zh: 当然，田纳西州只是其中一个州，

sentences.en: and researchers wanted to make sure
they weren't looking at a one-state phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 他们看到的并非只在一个州存在的现象。

sentences.en: So they turned to North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 所以他们把目光转向了北卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: This state has a huge public school database.
sentences.zh: 这个州有一个庞大的公立学校数据库。

sentences.en: It contains all kinds of information about students,
sentences.zh: 里面包含关于学生的各种信息，

sentences.en: and the race of various teachers over the years.
sentences.zh: 以及多年来各班老师的种族。

sentences.en: Again, the researchers looked at kids in elementary school
sentences.zh: 同样，研究人员调查了小学生的情况，

sentences.en: and then tracked them over time.
sentences.zh: 然后对他们进行了长期追踪。

sentences.en: Now, these kids weren't randomly matched
sentences.zh: 这些孩子并非像在田纳西州那样

sentences.en: but still, they had exposure to black and non-black teachers.
sentences.zh: 但他们依然接触过黑人教师和非黑人教师。

sentences.en: Constance says the results told the same story.
sentences.zh: 康斯坦斯表示，结果讲述了同样的故事。

sentences.en: Black kids who'd had black teachers
sentences.zh: 有过黑人老师的黑人孩子

sentences.en: were less likely to drop out of high school.
sentences.zh: 高中辍学的可能性更小。

sentences.en: And then, when you finish high school in North Carolina,
sentences.zh: 而且，当你在北卡罗来纳州读完高中时，

sentences.en: there's a survey you fill out that says,
sentences.zh: 有一份调查问卷需要填写，上面写着：

sentences.en: I will attend college, I will not attend college.
sentences.zh: 我会上大学，我不会上大学。

sentences.en: It's basically like an intent to attend college measure.
sentences.zh: 这基本上类似于一种上大学意向的衡量标准。

sentences.en: And we find that more black students
sentences.zh: 我们发现，有更多的黑人学生

sentences.en: who are matched to black teachers
sentences.zh: 如果分配给了黑人老师，
会表达出上大学的愿望。

sentences.en: Students who benefited the most from having a black teacher
sentences.zh: 从拥有黑人老师中获益最多的学生

sentences.en: were those most at risk of dropping out,
sentences.zh: 正是那些辍学风险最高的人，
也就是低收入的黑人男孩。

sentences.en: The North Carolina data showed that these boys
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州的数据表明，这些男孩

sentences.en: were 39% less likely to drop out of high school
sentences.zh: 高中辍学的可能性降低了 39%

sentences.en: if they had a black teacher in elementary school.
sentences.zh: 如果他们在小学时有一位黑人老师的话。

sentences.en: What Constance and her colleagues were seeing in education
sentences.zh: 康斯坦斯和她的同事在教育领域看到的现象

sentences.en: is what Owen Garrick saw in medicine.
sentences.zh: 正是欧文·加里克在医学领域看到的。

sentences.en: Now, we don't know why these black teachers
sentences.zh: 虽然我们不知道为什么这些黑人老师

sentences.en: in the lives of their black students,
a variety of forces might be at work.
sentences.zh: 这可能是多种因素共同作用的结果。
其中之一可能是隐性偏见。
老师们可能抱有无意识的偏见，
从而对黑人学生产生负面影响。

sentences.en: That prevent them from, you know,
sentences.zh: 这使得他们无法，你知道的，

sentences.en: maybe identifying kids for things like gifted programs
sentences.zh: 比如在挑选资优生项目时注意到这些孩子，
或者导致更严厉的纪律处分。

sentences.en: also serve as powerful role models
a college-educated adult in your life
sentences.zh: 有一个受过大学教育的成年人存在，

sentences.en: And then there's what's called cultural competence.
sentences.zh: 还有就是所谓的文化能力。

sentences.en: Which is that teachers are able to read behavior better
sentences.zh: 也就是说，如果你分享，你知道的，

sentences.en: if you sort of share, you know,
sentences.zh: 如果你有一些共同的文化背景，

sentences.en: if you have cultural things that you share in common.
sentences.zh: 老师就能更好地理解你的行为。

sentences.en: This seems especially true in the area of discipline.
sentences.zh: 这在纪律管教方面似乎尤其明显。

sentences.zh: 康斯坦斯和她的同事发现
黑人男孩有时在学校惹麻烦的

sentences.en: sometimes get into trouble at school

I get into an argument with the teacher
and then you have to go to the principal's office.
sentences.zh: 接着你就得去校长办公室了。

sentences.en: And so what do you see with willful defiance?
sentences.zh: 那么，从蓄意抗命上能看出什么呢？

sentences.en: the drops in willful defiance are huge
when you have a black teacher.
sentences.zh: 蓄意抗命的现象大幅减少。

sentences.en: But just as there's a shortage

sentences.zh: 黑人医生短缺的问题一样，

sentences.en: there's also a shortage of black teachers.
Nationwide, teachers in elementary and secondary schools
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，中小学教师

sentences.en: despite growing racial diversity among students.
sentences.zh: 尽管学生的种族多样性日益增加。

sentences.en: So for example, in the North Carolina data,
sentences.zh: 举个例子，在北卡罗来纳州的数据中，

sentences.en: and in the discipline study that I have,
sentences.zh: 还是在我手头纪律研究中，

sentences.en: Constance knows well the lasting impression
sentences.zh: 康斯坦斯深知黑人老师

sentences.en: a black teacher can leave on students.
sentences.zh: 能给学生留下持久的印象。

sentences.zh: 因为我的祖母曾在这里担任过教师

sentences.en: Public Schools for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 公立学校任教了很长时间。
是一位严厉而慈爱的老师。

sentences.zh: 会要求你对你应该做的事情负责，
